description: Read Data Processing Organization's real-time sovereign open-build index (ndex) and latest verified U.S. government surplus, federal RFP, IRS Form 990, and 17-digit VIN vault pulse. Zero credits required for discovery; returns canonical M2M endpoints and trial registration.

limit.description: Maximum number of ndex entries to return (1-100).

status_filter.description: Filter by st-code: '1' (verified live + '4' info bulletins, default), '2' (open-build), '4' (info only), or 'all' (public 1, 2, 4).

name: get_live_ndex_feed
